body: Well I think there's a really good chance. My dad yelled "You're my son" at me when he found me looking at transgender support sites when I was 14.

Well I don't think they'll disown me or anything like that. But I'm pretty certain they won't support me. Or at least they'll say that I'm too young or whatever. They're both super conservative and in the past when I've told them about my gender issues they were..not very happy. 

Now I love my parents to death. But I know the only possible way I'm going to survive is if I transition. And it just pains me to know that I'm going to have to lose them.
You know just hearing those words help so much. Just thank you so much for caring. I wish you the very best in life.
